recommendation: keep as research; diagnostic adapter only, default off
purpose: Verify numerical parity and input preservation of an original-guide sidecar before any native adapter use. This request is not a foliage image-quality acceptance claim.

pass.requested_compiler: DXC 1.8 matching the repository's audited local toolchain; record exact executable SHA256 and version
pass.execution: A separate read-only diagnostic dispatch. Do not bind its moments or flags as an AMD provider input.

stages.name: standalone_shader_parity
stages.inputs: Exact original typed crop tensors and analytic fixtures; preserve resource formats, original stored values and current/previous crop origins.

changed crop origins and unequal previous/current crop sizes
missing previous frame, frame gap, context/generation/reset and render-size changes
finite motion-B sentinel or incompatible depth must not produce temporal evidence
all-four-tap support and unchanged source words

stages.name: native_read_only_integration
stages.inputs: Leased original bridge guides and original pre-G3 bridge motion with explicit source lineage, as required by adapter/INTERFACE.json. Current provider motion is permitted only for the separately attributed standalone captured-fixture replay; it is not the live integration authority. Keep G3 on sourceInput D/S and RR/NZR on their existing owned physical D/S route.
stages.order: Retain actual provider chronology/reset/warmup. Observer reset is separate; do not reset AMD RR just because an exported observer crop starts.
checks: default OFF issues no diagnostic dispatch/allocation
diagnostic ON does not change any provider input descriptor or input/output words
previous snapshots survive until the consuming queue fence completes
no resource-generation reuse, descriptor alias or cross-context history

tolerances.standalone_flags: Exact; inspect every boundary disagreement, no percentile waiver

moments_normalized_components.rationale: Float32 normalization/dot arithmetic, manual point-tap interpolation, no sampler fraction quantization. Report max as well as p99 and exact failing coordinates.

relative_depth_span.rationale: Float32 depth difference/ratio may exceed one; never clip the statistic to pass.

gpu_timing_and_memory.request: Paired OFF/ON/sham timestamps over fixed warmup + 120 unlooped frames if available; report active pass and full-frame delta separately. Measure actual allocations, retained snapshots and transient row-pitch staging separately; opaque RR cost remains distinct.
gpu_timing_and_memory.off_budget: No added dispatch or allocation in production when disabled

visual_failure_criteria: new grain, specular sparkles or fine flicker
moving person/bottle trailing or glass/reflection change
delayed response to a real 1.1x or 1.25x light step
unreported unsupported history or altered masks
final_game_gate: Actual native AMD execution and matched-exposure/aspect/frame-time videos are required for any later image-quality claim. Include original historical facade/text controls; stored calibration witnesses and CPU surrogate images cannot substitute.
